summary.intent: Execute Phase 50 of CipherBox (IPFS/IPNS Data-Integrity Fixes) through the GSD manager — 5 plans covering integer-overflow in advisory lock hash, refcount-aware unpin drain, on-demand subtree IPNS traversal, quota-decrement on delete, and unpin-integrity dispositions. Then run the full post-execution pipeline: code review, fix findings, verify goals, close phase, resolve todos.
summary.outcome: All 5 plans executed across 2 waves with worktree isolation and TDD (RED→GREEN per plan). Code review found 2 real blockers (cycle guard missing, unhandled rejections) that were fixed before verification. Phase 50 passed 3/3 must-have goal checks, was marked complete, and the 2 pending todos it resolved were closed.

repo: GSD dep-parser mis-handles milestone version strings: 'Phase 49 (v1.1 baseline)' is parsed as phantom phase 1.1, marking real Phase 49 deps as unsatisfied — workaround is manual execution

pnpm/orval in isolated worktrees resolve node_modules and output paths to the monorepo root, not the worktree — running pnpm api:generate in a worktree leaks 131 regenerated api-client files plus client.ts into the main checkout

The cleanup-wave helper's internal merge-commit step fails silently when husky lint-staged runs eslint+prettier across 131 staged api-client files — it leaves MERGE_HEAD without error output; the merge content is correct and can be committed manually
gsd_run query commit reliably reports commit_failed false negatives even on successful commits — always verify with git log rather than trusting the helper's exit signal
Husky auto-generates .husky/_/* stubs during pnpm install in worktrees, leaving the worktree dirty and blocking cleanup-wave's pre-merge clean-tree check
Two orphaned worktree branches (agent-a92edd36, agent-abd7998d) exist from a prior session with no attached worktrees — left untouched to avoid scope creep
The worktree base-check degrades to 'baseref-head' (fork off current HEAD) when phase plan commits are only on the current branch, which is correct and safe

code.finding: collectSubtreeIpnsNamesAsync had no visited set for cycle detection despite docstring claiming to mirror ensureFolderLoaded DFS pattern (which has one at line 549). Recursion at lines 220/246/316 with no guard → unbounded recursion on folder cycles. Fixed: cycle guard added at param line 286, guard 293-294, child-skip 327-341.

Four fire-and-forget unenroll dispatch sites call collectSubtreeIpnsNamesAsync via .then() with no .catch() — unhandled rejection on cycle or network error silently aborts the delete. Fixed by adding .catch() at all four sites.

WR-01: after 50-02's refcount guard, the recheck and physical unpin still occur outside the advisory lock window — a concurrent re-pin can race between the recheck and the unpin. Low-frequency batched path; flagged for security review rather than blocking ship.
50-02 added refcount guard: skips physical unpin in drain when CID is re-pinned, preventing data loss on concurrent re-pin-during-drain scenario.
50-01 removed abs() from pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext($1)::bigint) — abs(INT_MIN) overflows back to INT_MIN in Postgres, making CIDs with that hash permanently undeletable.

workflow: Targeted post-merge tests (affected suites only) are correct here — full monorepo parallel suite risks RAM starvation and requires local infra for integration tests per project memory
Code review can surface real correctness blockers (cycle guard, unhandled rejections) that per-plan TDD unit tests miss because unit tests don't cover cross-plan integration paths
When a worktree's dirty state is only untracked regenerated files that exactly match what the merge will bring in, verifying hash equality then discarding is safe and correct
Manual merge completion (git commit after git merge leaves MERGE_HEAD) is a valid fallback when the cleanup-wave helper's commit step fails due to slow hook execution
The GSD phase complete command false-positives 'needs human verification' when previous_status: human_needed is in frontmatter history — expected, not an error

friction: GSD dep-parser phantom phase: 'Phase 49 (v1.1 baseline)' parsed as phase 1.1, requiring manual override to dispatch Phase 50

cleanup-wave helper failed silently on 50-05 merge: lint-staged across 131 api-client files exceeded the helper's internal timeout/retry budget, leaving MERGE_HEAD with no error — required manual diagnosis and commit

pnpm api:generate in worktree leaked 131 files + client.ts into main checkout, blocking the second cleanup-wave run for 50-05 and 50-03 — required verifying all dirty files matched worktree commits before discarding
Husky .husky/_/* stubs generated in worktrees during pnpm install blocked the first cleanup-wave run for 50-05 — required separate clean step
gsd_run query commit false-negative required verifying every tracking commit via git log separately
